items.source: This operation is only useful when the task execution is scheduled on a different thread than the original call stack; this depends on the choice of TaskExecutor. This is particularly useful for restoring a logging context or an observation context for the task execution. Note that this decorator will cause some overhead for task execution and is not recommended for applications that run lots of very small tasks.
items.translation: 此操作仅在任务执行安排在不同于原始调用栈的线程上时才有效；这取决于对TaskExecutor的选择。这对于恢复任务执行的日志上下文或观察上下文特别有用。请注意，此装饰器会导致任务执行产生一定的开销，因此不建议用于运行大量非常小任务的应用程序。

items.source: Decorate the given Runnable, returning a potentially wrapped Runnable for actual execution, internally delegating to the original Runnable.run() implementation.
items.translation: 装饰给定的 Runnable，返回一个可能经过包装的Runnable 用于实际执行，内部委托给原始的Runnable.run()实现。

items.source: Create a new decorator that uses a default instance of the ContextSnapshotFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个使用ContextSnapshotFactory默认实例的新装饰器。

items.source: Create a new decorator using the given ContextSnapshotFactory.
items.translation: 使用给定的ContextSnapshotFactory创建一个新的装饰器。

items.source: factory - the context snapshot factory to use.
items.translation: factory - 要使用的上下文快照工厂。
